_comment: Mutation score is the real signal; line coverage is only a floor. Runs nightly and on release, never on every push — see .github/workflows/nightly.yml. Two TypeScript-7 accommodations: tsconfig files are kept out of the sandbox, and the `typescript` checker is off, because Stryker 9.6 reaches for TS's legacy JS API (ts.parseConfigFileTextToJson) which TS 7 removed. Re-enable `checkers: ["typescript"]` + `tsconfigFile` once Stryker supports the TS7 API; the cost meanwhile is only that non-compiling mutants get run instead of pruned.
